mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the crank was the most worthwhile moment: its handle gave me a clearer idea of how the winder might work. The described winder is more interesting than the act of assembling it. Making this one project was of mixed worth for the time spent; the crank fitting helped, but the repeated fittings added little.

leastWorthwhile.text: I fitted the guide and anchor because the goals instructed me to; that was fine but repetitive. Hypothetically, I would shorten the assembly. That would lose some sense of where the individual parts go.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; each fitting went where the instructions and part descriptions suggested.

arbitrary.text: I followed the specified fitting order because the goals required it. The order felt somewhat arbitrary, though fitting the parts themselves made sense.

continue.text: I would stop here. I would be curious to see the carrier used across the gap, but these repeated fittings did not make me want another chapter.
